result.quote: “Look, Gaal son of Ebed and his brothers have come to Shechem and are stirring up the city against you.
result.reason: Verse 9:31 directly supports both parts of the key: Gaal and his brothers had arrived in Shechem and were stirring up the city against Abimelech. The edit retains the source’s intended focus on Zebul’s warning about Gaal inciting the city, while stating its content more specifically.
